material.text: @slkiser/opencode-quota: OpenCode quota & tokens usage with zero context window pollution. Supports GitHub Copilot, OpenAI (Plus/Pro), Google AGY, Z.ai coding plan and more.

type=plugin source=npm:@slkiser/opencode-quota created=2026-01-23T16:02:59.574Z firstSeen=2026-11-12T16:45:49.889Z published=2026-11-05T22:18:07.786Z maintainers=slkiser repoId=1140158649 stars=1142 npm30d=?

Quota, usage and cost in OpenCode TUI and Desktop.

English | 简体中文 | 繁體中文 | Français | Deutsch | 日本語 | Español

--- ## Install ```bash opencode plugin add @slkiser/opencode-quota ``` Restart OpenCode and type `/quota`. A window opens with your limits. Click a tab (Usage, Limits, Plugin, or a Settings tab) or press `tab` to move between them; click or press `esc` to close it. > [!IMPORTANT] > You need OpenCode `2.0.26+`; the terminal commands also need Node.js `22.13+` or `23.4+`. > [!NOTE] > Still on OpenCode 1? Run `npx @slkiser/opencode-quota@4 init` instead, and see the [OpenCode 1 README](https://github.com/slkiser/opencode-quota/blob/release/4.x/README.md).
Edit opencode.json yourself Add the plugin to `opencode.jsonc` or `opencode.json`, and keep your other plugins. In `~/.config/opencode` it works in every project; in a project's folder, only there. This one entry loads both the server and the TUI: ```jsonc { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "plugin": ["@slkiser/opencode-quota"], } ```
## What you get - **TUI:** a `/quota` window, a sidebar panel, a status line and toasts. - **Desktop (experimental, OpenCode `2.2.0+`):** a side tab, pills, a bottom strip, toasts, a usage window (**Quota** command) and a settings page. Turn it off in **Settings → Extensions → Plugins**.
Where each setting shows in the TUI and in Desktop
Setting groupTUIDesktop
sidebarQuota panel in the sidebarQuota side tab
collapsedSidebar panel folded to one line per providerTitlebar pill, and the Quota side tab when folded
statusLineLine under the message boxStrip at the bottom of the window, and the pill above the message box
toastToasts with barsToasts with the Quota side tab's rows and bars; a reset notice is a sentence

Note: in the TUI the status line hides while the sidebar shows quota, unless Next to the sidebar (statusLine.withSidebar) is on. In Desktop the strip also shows next to the Quota side tab by default; Next to the side panel (statusLine.withSidePanel) turns that off. statusLine.composerPill: false (Pill above the message box) hides only the pill in Desktop.

- **Web:** `/quota`, `/quota_usage` and `/quota_status` post a report in the chat. The AI never sees it. - **Terminal:** `npx @slkiser/opencode-quota@latest show`, even with OpenCode closed. - **Scripts and status bars:** JSON, an export file and metrics ([how](docs/readme/external-integration.md)). - **Live settings** in every open OpenCode. ## Commands | Command | What it shows | | ---------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `/quota` | Limits. Web and Desktop: limits next to the last 7 days of usage | | `/quota_usage [range]` | Tokens and API cost: `today` (default), `24h`, `7d`, `30d`, `90d`, `all`, `session` (with its subagents), `between` two dates | | `/quota_status` | Setup check: logins, providers, pricing, and notices | | `/quota_settings` | Settings tabs (TUI only) | For example `/quota_usage 30d` or `/quota_usage between 2026-09-01 2026-09-25`. In a terminal, with OpenCode open or closed, `npx @slkiser/opencode-quota@latest show` shows your quota and `npx @slkiser/opencode-quota@latest status` checks your setup ([how they differ](docs/readme/troubleshooting.md#terminal-commands)). Add `--help` to see all options. ## Settings - Change settings in `/quota_settings` (TUI) or the Quota page in Desktop's settings. Both save to `opencode-quota/settings.jsonc` in OpenCode's config folder and keep your comments. - Custom providers, the Claude CLI path and the export path are set only in the file. - The `┃` in a bar marks even use until the reset. **Even-use mark** (`layout.evenUse`) turns it off. - [Settings and defaults](docs/readme/configuration.md) ## Providers Log in with `/connect` and the provider shows up. Switch providers on or off in `/quota_settings` → **Providers**.
| American | Plans | | --- | --- | | [Anthropic (Claude)](docs/readme/providers.md#anthropic-claude)\* | Personal · Business | | [Cursor](docs/readme/providers.md#cursor)\* | Personal · Business | | [Gemini CLI](docs/readme/providers.md#gemini-cli)\* | Business | | GitHub Copilot | Personal · [Business](docs/readme/providers.md#github-copilot)\* | | [Google AGY](docs/readme/providers.md#google-agy-quick-setup)\* | Personal · Business | | Ollama Cloud | Personal | | OpenAI | Personal · Business | | OpenCode Go | Personal | | OpenCode Zen | Personal · Business | | OpenRouter | Personal · Business | | xAI | Personal · Business | | Chinese | Plans | | --- | --- | | [Alibaba Coding Plan](docs/readme/providers.md#alibaba-coding-plan)\* | Personal | | [Alibaba Token Plan](docs/readme/providers.md#alibaba-token-plan)\* | Personal · Business | | DeepSeek | Personal | | Kimi Code | Personal · Business | | Kimi Code (CN) | Personal · Business | | MiniMax Token Plan | Personal · Business | | MiniMax Token Plan (CN) | Personal · Business | | [Xiaomi MiMo](docs/readme/providers.md#xiaomi-mimo)\* | Personal | | Z.ai Coding Plan | Personal | | Zhipu Coding Plan | Personal · Business |
\* Linked names need one more step; the rest work once you log in. [What each one reports](docs/readme/providers.md#pre-configured-providers). - OpenAI ChatGPT needs a Codex login ([how](docs/readme/providers.md#openai-and-xai)). - Gemini CLI works only with Gemini Code Assist Standard or Enterprise (organization) accounts. Personal Google accounts use Google AGY. - Business plans of the Chinese providers show only your own API key's usage (Alibaba Token Plan: one Credits row per seat). - API keys come from OpenCode or an [environment variable](docs/readme/providers.md#api-keys). ### Custom providers Track any other provider, from its quota API or from a local estimate. Ask your agent to add a custom provider: it is saved switched off, and you switch it on in `/quota_settings` → **Providers**. [Copy-paste prompt](docs/readme/providers.md#custom-providers). ## Updating ```bash opencode plugin update ``` Restart OpenCode. Coming from 4.x or 5.x? Your settings convert on the first start, and the old `/tokens_*` commands still work. See [Updating](docs/readme/updating.md). ## Troubleshooting 1. Run `/quota_status` in an OpenCode session, or `npx @slkiser/opencode-quota@latest status` in a terminal. 2. Provider missing? Log in to it again in OpenCode 2. 3. Using a companion plugin (Cursor, Google)? List it **before** `@slkiser/opencode-quota` in `opencode.json`. 4. `claude` or `bl` not found? See [Service environment](docs/readme/troubleshooting.md#service-environment). 5. `/quota_usage` empty? Start OpenCode once, then use a model. 6. No Quota GUI in Desktop? It needs OpenCode `2.2.0+` and its switch on in **Settings → Extensions → Plugins**. Web shows no plugin GUI. More fixes: [Troubleshooting](docs/readme/troubleshooting.md). ## Reference Guides: [Configuration](docs/readme/configuration.md) · [Providers](docs/readme/providers.md) · [Troubleshooting](docs/readme/troubleshooting.md) · [External integration](docs/readme/external-integration.md) · [Updating](docs/readme/updating.md) Outside links: [OpenCode docs](https://opencode.ai/docs/) · [OpenCode config](https://opencode.ai/docs/config/) · [OpenCode plugins](https://opencode.ai/docs/plugins/) · [OpenCode TUI](https://opencode.ai/docs/tui/) · [models.dev pricing data](https://models.dev/) · [Node.js downloads](https://nodejs.org/en/download) ## Contributors Thanks to everyone who has contributed to OpenCode Quota. ## License MIT.
